A '''Mod scooter''' was a modified [[Zeta-150B]] [[grav scoot]] [[speeder]] used by the [[Mods|Mod gang]] in the streets of [[Mos Espa]].

{{Veh-stub}}

==Description==
Mod scooters were painted in bright [[color]]s of metal flake paint that made them stand out in the harsh desert environment of [[Tatooine]].<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|customized-grav-scoot|Customized grav scoot}}</ref> While the [[repulsorcraft]] outwardly resembled a [[speeder bike]], their slower speed and bulky chassis classified them as an open-air speeder.<ref name="SWE CGSWG" />

==History==
When the Mods stole [[water]] from the [[water monger]] [[Lortha Peel]], they escaped on their customized scooters.<ref name="SWE CGSWG" /> After they became employed by [[Boba Fett]], the new [[Daimyo]] of Mos Espa, the Mods used their scooters to pursue [[Mok Shaiz]]'s [[Mok Shaiz's majordomo|majordomo]], who was attempting to evade capture in a [[Mok Shaiz's luxury speeder|luxury landspeeder]], ultimately causing him to crash into a fruit cart.<ref name="Chapter 3" />

Later, they patrolled the [[Mos Espa spaceport|spaceport]] on their grav scoots to monitor the arrival of [[Pyke Syndicate]] foot soldiers for Boba Fett<ref name="Chapter 3" /> and once [[Battle of Mos Espa|open conflict]] began for control of the city, escaped the [[Worker's District]] after being ambushed by the [[Aqualish crime family]].<ref name="Chapter 7">{{BOBF|Chapter 7: In the Name of Honor}}</ref>
